mod = 1000000007

if K == 0:
    ans = 1
    for i in range(1, P):
        ans = (ans * P) % mod
    print(ans)
else:
    mark = [0] * (P + 1)
    cycle = [0] * (P + 1)
    vec = []

    for i in range(1, P):
        if not mark[i]:
            nd = i
            length = 0
            while not mark[nd]:
                mark[nd] = 1
                nd = (K * nd) % P
                length += 1
            cycle[length] += 1
            vec.append(length)

    ans = 1
    for length in vec:
        tmp = (length * cycle[length]) % mod
        ans = (ans * (tmp + 1)) % mod

    if K == 1:
        ans = (ans * P) % mod

    print(ans)
